context: Two elderly neighbors swap vegetable-growing and cooking tips
purpose: Teach: 牛乳/サラダ/キッチン/チョコ/食っ/栽培/分解/望ん

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 佐知子さん、今年もトマトの栽培、うまくいっとるかね？
lines.en: Sachiko-san, is your tomato cultivation going well this year too?
lines.style: Warm, slightly raspy elderly male tone, friendly neighborly greeting over the fence

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: おかげさまでね。今朝もキッチンで山ほど刻んで、サラダにしましたよ。
lines.en: Thanks to you. This morning I chopped a mountain of them in the kitchen and made a salad.
lines.style: Gentle grandmotherly warmth, soft cheerful pace, proud of her morning harvest

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ええなあ。わしは昨日、孫が来て、ケーキを食って帰っていったわ。
lines.en: How nice. Yesterday my grandkid came over, ate cake, and went home.
lines.style: Affectionate chuckle, slightly rough rural inflection, doting grandfather mood

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あらまあ。お孫さん、甘い物を望んでばかりでしょう？うちも昔そうでしたよ。
lines.en: Oh my. Your grandchild only ever wants sweet things, right? Ours were the same long ago.
lines.style: Tender laugh, knowing motherly tone, soft falling intonation at end

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そうなんよ。チョコばっかりでな、牛乳で流し込んどったわ。
lines.en: That's right. It was all chocolate, and he was washing it down with milk.
lines.style: Knowing chuckle, fond grandfatherly exasperation, slow deliberate rural delivery

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ふふ、元気でなによりですよ。ところで土の方はどうしてらっしゃるの？
lines.en: Hehe, his energy is the main thing. By the way, how are you managing your soil?
lines.style: Warm chuckle pivoting to gardening topic, gentle curious upward lilt

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 落ち葉をしっかり分解させてな、それを肥料に混ぜとるんよ。
lines.en: I let fallen leaves fully decompose, then mix that into the fertilizer.
lines.style: Older man sharing gardening wisdom, slow deliberate confident delivery

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: それは賢いやり方ですねえ。家庭栽培は土が命と聞きますもの。
lines.en: That's a clever method, isn't it. They say for home cultivation, the soil is everything.
lines.style: Genuinely impressed, soft admiring tone, slight upward lilt of respect

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そうそう。今度うちの落ち葉、少し分けたるわ。
lines.en: Exactly. Next time I'll share some of our fallen leaves with you.
lines.style: Encouraging warm grandfatherly enthusiasm, friendly closing offer

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: まあ嬉しい。お礼にうちのトマトでサラダ作ってお持ちしますね。
lines.en: Oh how lovely. In return I'll make a salad with our tomatoes and bring it over.
lines.style: Cheerful warm promise, gentle laugh, kind neighborly farewell tone
